title: Nikita Bier steps down as head of product at X after a little more than a year in the role and says he will continue as an adviser (Sean O'Kane/TechCrunch)
summary: Sean O'Kane / TechCrunch: Nikita Bier steps down as head of product at X after a little more than a year in the role and says he will continue as an adviser — Nikita Bier has stepped down as head of product at X, Elon Musk's social media platform, after a little more than a year in the role.
